title: fix(objectql): a write answers every stored declared column the driver did not echo as null, as the next read does (#29538)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8N41nMAvUJQvgDEc6wx2yb6)_
Fixes #29538

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 新建与按 id 更新的返回记录,对驱动没有回显的已存储声明列补 `null`,和紧接着的一次读取完全一致;本次写入自己带了值(或更新前已存值)的列不补 `null`,驱动没回显就照旧缺省。
- **为什么改:** mongo / memory 驱动上,新建或编辑后的返回体缺少未写的字段,而下一次 GET 同一行却把它们答成 `null`;客户端拿到同一条记录的两个不同版本,公式字段在返回体里还会报错为 `null`。
- **风险与回滚:** 只改返回体,不改存储内容,也不改读路径;区分「缺键」和「`null`」的读者现在读到 `null`(driver-sql 一直如此)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看:** `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` 插入结果处的 `storedColumnsLeftUnwritten` 调用(批量按行配对 payload);同文件按 id 更新回读处;`packages/objectql/src/declared-read-columns.ts` 新增的 `storedColumnsLeftUnwritten`。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/write-answer-declared-columns.test.ts`,预期 32 个用例全过。
- **需要你做的:** 无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **The write answer is the next read's record.** `ObjectQL.insert` (single, batch, and each `insertMany` outcome) and the by-id `update` readback now answer every stored declared column the driver did not echo as `null`, reusing #29408's `selectedStoredColumns` + `withSelectedColumnsAnswered` (no copy). Placed right after the existing `withDeclaredColumnsOnly` shaping, before the formulas and the after-hooks, so a formula over an unwritten column evaluates against `null` as the read does, and the security middleware's field mask still deletes an FLS-refused key afterwards. Every door on those two verbs answers alike: `POST /data/:object`, `PATCH /data/:object/:id`, `createManyData`, `updateManyData`, `batchData` create / update / both upsert arms.
- **Never a `null` the row does not hold** (new in this round, `storedColumnsLeftUnwritten` in `declared-read-columns.ts`). A column the insert payload, or the PATCH and then the raw stored row read before it, carries a non-null value for is stored, so it is left out of the fill: a driver that stores it without echoing it leaves it absent, as before. A PATCH `null` stays answerable. On driver-sql, driver-memory and driver-mongodb the echo is the stored row, so this changes nothing there. It is what the consumer sweep asked for: `trigger-record-change`'s flow record overlays the write result on the input (`{ ...previous, ...input.data, ...after }`, #1872), and a fabricated `null` there overwrote a written multi-lookup value (`multilookup-context.test.ts` red, below).
- **Unchanged:** what a write stores; the read path #29408 landed; a predicate update's affected-row count; the read's exclusions (formula, unprovisioned injected, federated-unprovisioned, undeclared, FLS-refused stay absent).
- Changeset `.changeset/29538-write-answer-declared-column-null.md`: `@objectstack/objectql` patch, both declaration lines.

## Why

After #29408 every read answers an unwritten declared column `null` on every driver, but the write answer still came straight from the driver: driver-sql echoed `null`, driver-mongodb and driver-memory echoed only the stored keys. A create on mongo or memory answered `{ title: 'x' }` and the very next `GET` answered `{ title: 'x', note: null }`; a formula over `note` answered `null` (a fault) in the create response and its value on the `GET`. Ruling-ref 6584622486 (contract review on #29528, open_question 2 answered B: this follow-up).

## Tests

- New pins: `objectql/src/write-answer-declared-columns.test.ts` (sparse driver, 12 write paths `toStrictEqual` the next `findOne`, formula control; plus 4 cases for a driver that stores a column without echoing it: insert, batch per row, update with a prior stored value, PATCH clearing to `null`), `runtime/src/declared-column-null-on-write.test.ts` (driver-sql and a sparse stub with `SecurityPlugin`: FLS-refused column absent from the member's insert / batch / update answers, `null` for system), `driver-mongodb/src/mongodb-declared-column-null-on-write.test.ts` (fake `Db`; the single-row arms' collection declares only `insertOne` / `updateOne` / `findOne`, the batch arm's only `insertMany` / `find`).
- **Forced test edits (six assertions in four files, plus the hook reads in a fifth).** Each read "left unset" off the write answer on a sparse stub; each now asserts the answer is `null` AND the stored row has no key. Per file, the production caller that reads the write answer for that key today:
  - `engine-default-value-tokens.test.ts` (`owner`, a lookup whose `current_user` default resolves to nothing): **none.** `grep` for `.owner === undefined`, `.owner !== undefined`, `'owner' in` over `packages/`, `examples/`, `ui/` non-test source: 0 hits. The readers of a write answer that do exist (record-change flow record, which materialises missing declared fields to `null` anyway; plugin-audit; the REST doors) treat absent and `null` alike.
  - `engine-lookup-referential-integrity.test.ts` (`recorded_by`, a readonly lookup stripped before the reference check): **none.** Test-local field; no production code reads a stripped field off a write answer as `undefined` (same grep shape, 0 hits).
  - `engine-select-option-default.test.ts` ×3 (`status`, `tags`): **none.** `grep (record|row|result|created|data).(status|tags) (===|!==) undefined`: one hit, `examples/app-todo/src/objects/task.hook.ts:86`, which reads `data.status` = `ctx.input.data` (the PATCH payload), not the write answer.
  - `engine-write-formula-hydration.test.ts` (the KEY SET of the `createData` record): **none.** `grep Object.(keys|entries)((created|updated|inserted|saved|written)…)`: one hit, `core/src/utils/import-runner.ts:799`, which iterates the import's payload, not the answer; `ui/`: 0 hits. The assertion now also `toStrictEqual`s the next read.
  - `protocol-save-notice-answer.test.ts` (`say_after` on `ctx.result` in after-hooks): **none.** Test-local field; `grep ctx.result` with `undefined` / `in` / `hasOwn` / `Object.keys` in production source: only `runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts:672`, which tests the whole `ctx.result`, not a key.
- The one real consumer that relied on the old answer was not one of these six: `trigger-record-change/src/multilookup-context.test.ts`. It was fixed upstream in the engine (above), not by editing the test.

<details><summary>Ablations (each: mutation on disk, objectql rebuilt, marker proven in dist/, restore proven by blob == HEAD and the marker absent from dist/)</summary>

- A1 insert fill removed → 14 objectql, 2 driver-mongodb and 2 runtime reds. A2 update fill removed → 11, 1 and 2. A3 insert fill moved after the security mask → the FLS pin reds on both runtime drivers. A4 the same for update → the FLS pin reds again. (A1–A4 measured by the previous dev on `1cb3f6a3`, hand-off 6591637215.)
- A5 `storedColumnsLeftUnwritten` made a no-op (fill everything) → 3 of the 4 new non-echo pins red + `trigger-record-change` `multilookup-context` red; the PATCH-clears-to-`null` pin stays green, as a control should.
- A6 the write fill emptied → all 3 driver-mongodb arms red. (A first A6 attempt failed the DTS build and measured nothing; re-run with a typed mutation.)
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Engine-level write results keep `internal: true` fields whole (the A-prime ruling), so an engine-level write answer still differs from an engine `findOne` there on every driver. Pre-existing, out of scope; the REST doors strip them.
- Two gate reds on this PR's own new test code were instrument readings, fixed in the tests without touching any gate or ledger: `check:engine-double-contract` counted the mongo pin's native `Collection` fake as an engine double (`find` + `insertMany` are in `ENGINE_SIBLINGS`, `insertMany` in `ENGINE_ONLY_MEMBERS`), and `check:where-matcher` lifted the `driver` literal into the sparse fake's matcher because its refusal text said "sparse driver". Both are reported to the seat.

## Verification

All on head `77b6b65dd` (base `origin/main` merged at `143b91915`), unless noted. Every heavy run went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`; each line quotes its `VERDICT` exit.

- Touched packages: `@objectstack/objectql` test 545/545 files, 10792 passed; `driver-mongodb` 35 passed + 6 skipped files, 728 passed / 194 skipped; `runtime` 535/535 files, 8562 passed / 19 skipped; `trigger-record-change` 12/12, 121 passed. Typecheck (incl. `check:test-typecheck`) exit 0 for objectql, runtime, driver-mongodb.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 63 derived; each run, exit codes recorded; `--ran` → "63 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". `pnpm lint` exit 0.
- Dogfood battery on `94b04574b` (the later commits are test-only edits and a merge of `main`): closure build exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` exit 0, 399 passed + 3 skipped files, 3297 passed / 28 skipped, 0 failed.

<details><summary>Downstream consumer sweep (prefix direction: packages whose tests boot a real ObjectQL), on f847848c after the engine fix, all exit 0</summary>

objectql 544 files · runtime · driver-mongodb · driver-memory · rest · plugin-security · plugin-audit · trigger-record-change 12/12 · metadata-protocol 308 + 4 skipped · service-analytics 208 · plugin-auth 215 · plugin-approvals 110 · service-messaging 63 · service-storage 71 · service-settings 67 · plugin-sharing 63 · service-automation 262 · service-datasource 70 · plugin-webhooks 25 · client 54 · organizations 18 · example-showcase 45 · plugin-email 48 · service-mailbox 10 · driver-odata 9 · plugin-pinyin-search 4 · connector-mcp 9 · cloud-connection 67 · example-crm 7 · cli 566 + 1 skipped.

The first pass (on `3597f584`, before the carried-value rule) had 22 of those 23 sweep packages green and `trigger-record-change` red 1 (`multilookup-context.test.ts`: `expected null to be 'ch_1'`), which the engine change above fixes.
</details>
